title: Johann Heinrich Lambert's memoir "Theorie der Parallellinien": A review with commentary
summary: We review the memoir \emph{heorie der Parallellinien} by Johann Heinrich Lambert, written in 1766. Lambert, a victim of the prejudices of his time, conceived this memoir as an attempt to prove the so-called parallel postulate of Euclid's \emph{Elements}, and consequently, the non-existence of the geometry that we now call hyperbolic geometry. In fact, by developing the foundations of a geometry obtained by replacing the parallel postulate with its negation while keeping Euclid's other postulates unchanged, Lambert was hoping to arrive at a contradiction. Of course, he failed in his endeavor,…
